answer: Mutual thread audit blocks mass fake identities. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, files a dated thread in the reef ledger, and pays a 30 fee. After filing, a raven courier assigns a random peer auditor so no one picks a friendly judge. The auditor replays the thread on a public lantern board; copying burns the 70 bond, and an auditor who clears a fake loses a 30 stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 versus a 40,000 pool, a 60,000 loss, while a twin-thread ring is exposed and both bonds burn. An honest agent pays 30 once.
